tagline: A clearer voice. All on your PC.
cleanup_help: Switch off to compare the original on the same route.
no_cable: VB-CABLE is required to appear as a microphone in calling apps.
setup_steps:
1. Separately install VB-CABLE from its publisher when ready; a restart may be needed.
2. Refresh devices, choose your microphone and CABLE Input here.
3. Select CABLE Output in the calling app. Nothing changes your default devices.
